name: Deva Center
content:
Deva Center

Deva International Society for Child Care (DISCC),   Varanasi is a registered NGO from 28 years. Established in 1991 its main focus is to help children and Families from various childhood Mental, Physical and emotional problems and to train parents in effective parenting skills and Technique. Also to sensitize and train government, Semi Govt. and private organizations and officers in prevention of child abuse, trafficking and various other Mental health problems such as disabilities among children and to rehabilitate such victims. Since last 28 years the organization has won many awards and felicitations even from Prime Minister Mr. Narendra Modi for its services in the field of child psychiatric problems. The institution Deva Center caters to the needs of UP, Bihar, Nepal and it is 1st in Varanasi to do such services. It is well connected Nationally and Internationally with USA, France, Holland, Dubai, Re- Union Island, and has all the transparencies and accountabilities in its ventures.  Dr. Tulsi is the chief Psychologist, Counselor and Psychotherapist and founder President of this organization. Last but not the least, The project SAAHAS with Police services of UP is the result of this organization.

name: Annapurna Center
content:
Annapurna Center

Annapurna Center Situated at about 13 km from, VARANASI City,  “Annapurna Center” is the second project of "DISCC". This center was established in 1995 to cater to the needs of poor, rural women and the girl child. The main objective of this rural social club is to make these women and girls confident in their own self, to make them understand about preventive and promotive aspects of health and to train them in some culturally tailored vocational activities, At present there are twenty girls and married women who come at the social club and learn various social activities .The center is managed by an Educated women from the same village.       

Cultural program, Health Camps, Skill-Training workshops etc. are organised from time to time for their benefit

name: Help Line
content:
Help Line

Emergency Help to Children and Families

HELP LINE, as the name indicates, is meant for extending immediate medical, social,or emergency medical support to the family, who are unable to help themselves because of the poverty, or due to any other reason.  Primarily, this help line extends helping hand to children in need but as the child cannot be separated from the family, if some thing goes wrong with the family, then also the family is supported and rehabilitated by the DISCC.

This kind of project in separate form came into our mind because we found that, there are some children, who don’t fit in to other category of project we are doing, but we also felt that, they need our help immediately. Also, if we don’t help them, then some kind of problem is going to come in their life in general. Keeping this objective in our mind, we designed this project.

Through, Help line project, we are able to help many children and also adults in getting rid of their medical problems, helped families in grave needs. There are many stories in this help line to be told.

 

FUNDING

Most of the funding for the help line project comes from the Individual sponsorship programmes on the international level.

name: Child Education Program
content:
Children Educational Program


 A preparatory Center for providing Basic Education to Socially Deprived Children

Gangotri is the name of the place from where the Mother Ganges originates in Himalayas. This preparatory school is situated below a tree near the banks of river Ganges.

The school provides education, confidence, health and hygiene skills to the kids who had no previous experience of any school. It mainly stresses on ‘Value Based Education’ through story telling and games and tries to bring the best in them. After looking at the motivational level of the top scorers and good students of the school in education, they are shifted to a better school .All the educational requirements including school fee, study material and school dresses are provided free of cost. Time to time, parents meeting are also held to motivate the parents.

name: Dr-tulsi-other-psychological-ventures
content:
First Community based Psychologist 

and 

Mental Health Professional,  Uttar Pradesh

 

Dr. Tulsi is a senior mental health specialist with expertise in the field of Mental Health promotion & Prevention through eastern & western autonomic self regulation therapies and Rehabilitative approaches for various Psychological Problems and Intellectual Disability Rehabilitation and family empowerment programs.   

Since 1991 through DISCC, Varanasi, an NGO and later on through Changemakers Inc, a corporate organization, he has conducted more than 60000+  consultations, Family counseling programs. He has conducted more than 5000+ National & International workshops, coaching & Individual Therapy sessions related with stress, ADHD, Sexual Abuses, Drug addiction, domestic violence, anxiety & depression, anger management, school problems, psychosomatic problems.   

Through changemekers.Inc he has conducted more than 10000 coaching programs to empower school students, youth from colleges and Universities, Police departments in Stress Management, Personality Development, self confidence, Motivation, Work life Balance, Burn out syndromes. His programs on Trauma Management through different Meditative practices have been internationally acclaimed in USA, Middle East, France, Holland, Re-Union Islands and Germany. As a Rotarian MJF from Varanasi Shiv Ganga he was ambassador to Paris, France and Germany.      

Dr. Tulsi’s decades-long work has resulted in trans formative impact at multiple levels:

Individual Level: Through 60,000+ consultations, family counseling programs and rehabilitation and integration of children in main stream through DISHA VIKAAS program of National Trust, through his innovative techniques, Dr. Tulsi has directly improved the lives of intellectually disabled children and their families. His approach has enabled children once considered not useful for family & society are now helping and caring family work, family shops, self employ and become contributing members of society.

Family Level: His unique focus on the Trauma Management of mental health of mothers and caregivers through Meditative approaches has brought healing and confidence to countless families. The recent program of his meditation and trauma-relief program at PARIWAR Society function at Baranas Hindu University for 600 mothers and care givers is a first-of-its-kind initiative in India.

Community Awareness Programs: Dr. Tulsi farmly believes awareness program should not be only aimed to showcase disability issues, rehabilitation integration of them in main stream but also like “ Pulse Polio Program” which brought complete eradication of Polio from India we should also “PULSE DISABILITY” programs for awareness in this area for people who are still not marred  to prevent pregnancies and births of  disabled children in their families. Keeping this more than 500 awareness campaigns, across Uttar Pradesh have been carried out under his leadership. This has led to changed perceptions and reduced stigma around disability and mental health in urban and rural areas alike.

Institutional Reform: As a governing council member and policymaker of NIEPID, Secunderabad, ARUNIM, National Trust member, Dist. President Special Olympic, Member Local Level Committee of Varanasi dist, his recommendations have led to real changes in training and rehabilitation protocols and inclusive education, helping thousands beyond his direct reach.

Global Outreach: By collaborating Internationally with like minded people, institutions and Universities such as MSH France, Al AIN Dubai, and Oshkosh University USA. He has brought global best practices to India and shared India’s Yoga, Pranayam and Indian Therapy techniques with a worldwide audience, creating a two-way flow of knowledge and empathy.

Recognition: The 2021 award from the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, along with honors from Rotary International, Lions International, and Other International institutions and National Institutions like BHU, Dayal Bagh University, Agra have  underline the lasting value and credibility of his contributions.

name: Changemakers, Inc
content:
Discover yourself  with Changemakers, Inc

Changemakers Advisers Pvt. Ltd. is a Global group of High profile corporate, International Psychologists and Behavioral experts who strongly believe the change is the only constant. They have a strong believe that Human Potential has no limits and one can achieve the desired success and reach the top through awakening their resourceful state by means of psychological Techniques and various coaching programs. 

Dr. Tulsi who is the CEO, facilitator and coach of Changemakers has more than 30 years of National and International Experience in this Field and he is the First Psychologist of Uttar Pradesh, who gave an independent Scientific dimension to the field of Psychology and Mental Health Promotion. He has been a Visiting Prof. to various countries like France, Holland , Re union Islands  and Middle East. He held the Post of chief Psychologist of BHU, Varanasi and trained more than 50000 youths ,officials, and families in these Mental health promotion Skill development  programs. Some of the programs are stress and burnout management, High power communication skills, Confidence building and personality development, Leadership Qualities and success, Power of positive thinking, Marital Harmonies and various other mental health issues of day to day life at Individual and group level. 

More recently, Prime Minister Mr. Modi Ji  ,during his visit to Varanasi has also facilitated his efforts by honoring his Services and Disability issues by honoring his Institution Children .At present he is attached with UP100, Police Force as a Consultant on Various Psychological Issues and Mental Health Emergencies. About 5oo Police Force personnel’s of UP100 have been trained by him under training the trainers programme.

name: Gangotri
content:
Gangotri

Varanasi city is one of the oldest living cities in the world, located in Uttar Pradesh (U.P. State) of India. It is a multi religious, multi cultural city with approximately Population. Apart from this population all most. 

population are travelers and migratory people from other states who come here for their religious rituals or some in search of job and livelihood. A major part of job seekers are from west Bengal, Bihar which has scarcity of jobs for low socio economic status people(Earning below Rs.2500 per month). Most of these families are uneducated and they don’t have any place to stay. such families settled down on the west bank of Ganga River between the Rajghat bridge and Assi , a place in the  South part of Varanasi.  Most of them stay in very small hut type of settlements (one room 2Í 3 meters) where there is lack of space, lack of water facility and other facilities which are needed for such migratory people and families. A prominent area near Assi Ghat (On the bank of Assi) is known as Nagwan locality. The male family members of these families work as a labor, rickshaw pullers or small skilled artisans whereas female members are family work as maid servants. 

2- Generally , because of both of the family members are working, children of the family are  alone in the house or they are in the street wondering and doing small pity jobs such as selling of flowers, post cards, lamps, greeting cards or even getting involved  in gangs of drug pushers and pity crimes. And sometimes also being abused by the elders .

3- As it was observed by Jean-Max and Dr. Tulsi that a number of such children are wondering without any formal education, values in their life. It was thought to start a small preparatory center for these children.

4- As there were no place available for such preparatory school in 1999 it was started below a tree in a house in Assi area. The reason for choosing this area was firstly, because most of the children were from this area and it was the central place where children from Nagwan and Assi area can come walking without any difficulty. The reason for choosing this place was also because of Ms Manju who was very much motivated in helping us through her teaching skills. Also, as she was from the area she knew most of the families and families had confidence in her.

name: Ambedkar
content:
Ambedkar


While visiting one of the Village near Varanasi district (approximately 50 km from Varanasi,City ) " DISCC " president and his  associates found that , the village has many poor children both boys and girls ranging from 4 yrs to 10 yrs, who are roaming in the village without any formal schooling.Dr Tulsi,as a curiosity asked the  community leader that why the situation is like that and why children are not going to regular  school as other children in other villages. It was found that because of the poor economic states of the family and because of the backward states of people, villages were unable to send  their childern to any goods School. After two or three visits to the village community a request came from the community  head that  “DISCC " can start a small school for the village children only. After thinking and assessing the need of the community a  small school "AMBEDKAR INTEGRATED SCHOOL"  was established in one of the house  of  the "Nakati Raghunathpur village.30 boys and girls, whose parents were highly motivated were selected for two hour school programme. One teacher and One assistant teacher with sound of academic background from the same community there taken as teacher. Also, they were given a Refresher Course in teaching village children at "Deva Centre" Varanasi. 30 children were provided all the children have joined this open school atmosphere. School runs  for 3 hours and all the academic curriculum is being taught by 4 teachers from the same community who are giving their services. At present materials needed for beginning of the education. At present, school is doing very good and about 70 more, some funding which currently needed, every month, is funded by "DISCC".

name: Navjeevan
content:
Navjeevan


A new introduction into the ongoing program of  “DISCC”, which is called Navjeevan Project. ‘Navjeevan’ is a Hindi Word, which means, “giving a new life”. The project is aimed at catering to the different types of “leprosy” patients, their families & their children. The main aim is to give a new dimension to their life, so that they can have a place in the society as any other individual.  It was felt that it is this group of individuals and their families who are in the most neglected stream of the society in general. Most of such “Leprosy” patients who are either in the active phase of the disease or the passive phase, lead a miserable life.

Most of such leprosy patients earn their lively hood through begging and can be seen near the banks of Ganges River. More especially, near “DASHASHVMEDH GHAT”, “SANKAT MOCHAN TEMPLE”, Varanasi. There have been few efforts made by humanitarian people from national and international backgrounds to all acivet the problem here of time. But due to lack of very good cooperation and co-coordinators, these projects have not continued for a long period or it has failed to each the benefices. 

Keeping the above points in mind, a small clinic  “NAVJEEVAN” has been started few months back (May-2000) near “DASHASHVMEDH GHAT”, VARANASI. Through “Navjeevan” Clinic, “DISCC”, staff conduct the bandaging, dressing and medical help, and try to fulfill the different needs of this community approximately 40 to 50 Leprosy Patients every week are, being helped through this program.

There is no Government funding for the above projects. Thanks to friends residing in India and abroad and the generous donations and sponsorship, we have been able to bring up to this level.

name: Deva Institute for the Empowerment of Disabilities
content:
Deva Institute for the Empowerment of Disabilities

(A Project Of DISCC)   

Deva Institute for Empowerment of Disabilities  

Location: Bachhaon Village, Varanasi, India , 

Deva Institute is committed to providing Awareness, Detection, Training, Rehabilitation and Empowerment programs for children and adults with Intellectual disabilities. Side by side it also provides information and Empowerment programs for others 21 kinds of Disabilities exiting in India.

The institute offers various services, including:

- Day care programs for intellectually disabled children

- Respite hostel care for children and their families

- Pre – Vocational Training

- Vocational Training

- Economic empowerment programs

- Different types of Therapies including Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy, Garden Therapy, Hydro Therapy, Sensory Training, Early Interventions, Music & Dance Therapy, Training in Special Olympic Sports & Games and various other activities and programs if required.

Run by Deva International Society for Child Care (DISCC Varanasi), the institute relies on support from individuals and government grants.
